title: Ising spins with Hadamard couplings
description: A real Hadamard matrix H of order N defines a system of 2N Ising spins, carried by 2 layers of crossed wires, with couplings Hjk/√N between the layers. This is the switching game of Gale and Berlekamp at finite temperature, and having symmetric orthogonal couplings, it is a deterministic instance of the random orthogonal model of Marinari, Parisi and Ritort. The density of states is the real glow of H. We show that its law modulo 16 is determined by N and the 2-rank r of H, that its moments are universal polynomials in N up to order 14, the first correction being given by the 4-profile of H, and that the high-temperature expansion of the free energy is universal to leading order, with a continued paramagnetic entropy which vanishes at β = √240. At N = 16 the 5 densities of states form a 1-parameter family, the parameter being the number 214−r − 128 of crystalline ground states, at N = 20 they coincide, and at N = 24, 28, 32 they form families with 2, 4 and at least 8 parameters.
